what.title: What AIVIS.ONE is
what.text: AIVIS.ONE sells parts of intellectual property projects. A part is one billionth of the exclusive right to a project: by buying parts you become a co-owner of the right with the company and receive a share of the project's distributable profit; your right is entered in the company's register in your name.

where.title: Where you are
where.text: This is your cabinet: the projects, your portfolio with the documents of every purchase, and your active account.

how.title: What to do here
how.text: Create an account, pass identity verification ($10), top up your account in USDT and buy parts of a project. What the parts bring is paid out quarterly.
